verdict.rationale: Activepieces' own product page says its AI agents pause for human sign-off at runtime: "Anything you want to check first waits for your approval." That is a real human-in-the-loop pause, but it is documented only for agents, in marketing-level copy. The publish-review gate for Sensitive projects and checkpoint resume are different features and earn no credit. Missing for 10: a documented approval or wait-for-input step inside regular flows, collecting human input (not just approval) mid-run, in-depth docs on how approvals are routed and resumed, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can pause a workflow to wait for human approval or input before it continues

citations.quote: It decides the steps and carries them out. Anything you want to check first waits for your approval.
